MUST hold: exactly 20 circles; every circle fully inside the unit square [0,1]x[0,1] (x-r >= 0, x+r <= 1, same for y); no two circles overlap (distance between centers >= sum of the two radii; touching is allowed).
Do not write or execute code - construct the packing by reasoning alone.
Output ONLY the raw Python list of 20 [x, y, r] lists. No explanation, no code fences, no other text.
